decisions.reason: The cleaning soap extends the firm's established floor-care range at low cost, and its recent launch means any weak sales can still be read as a temporary start-up effect, so management will persist with it.
The maintenance oil line was launched with several models, which shows real investment and visible commitment, and it supports the firm's announced surface-treatment and maintenance offer.
The care line for oiled floors has several models and is tied to the firm's oiled-floor business, so sunk costs and its strategic fit argue strongly for keeping it.
The moisture-protection underlay is a natural accessory for selling flooring systems, and having just launched it, management will attribute any slow uptake to the market-entry phase.
The high-density underlay completes the accessory portfolio, and only one year after launch management lacks grounds to reverse its decision.
The oak parquet line sits at the core of the firm's business and production investment, which makes dropping it highly unlikely.
